title: Meh
text: I have the multi cat box and have gotten two boxes so far.  Each box had several stuffed catnip toys, a teaser wand, and a small bag of treats.  It's not bad, my cats like the stuff, but I expected more variety.  Catnip toys make them happy, of course, but they don't have a lot of play value beyond that.  The themes are sort of cute- first theme was diners, second was health and wellness (it had yoga pants and a faux protein bar) but I guess it just feels too formulaic.  I was expecting more variety.
label: positive
